description_en: Submits a job of importing text files to a text fingerprint library
name: ImportFpShotJob

parameters.help_en:
The Object Storage Service (OSS) URL of the text file to be imported to the text fingerprint library. The value must be a JSON object. Example: {"Bucket":"example-bucket","Location":"oss-cn-shanghai","Object":"example.flv"}.

The OSS bucket must reside in the same region as your MPS service
parameters.help_zh:
导库⽂件的OSS地址，JSON对象。例如：`{"Bucket":"example-bucket","Location":"oss-cn-shanghai","Object":"example.txt"}`。

OSS的地域需要与当前MPS所在地域保持一致
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraVideo Media Processing (MPS) queue. To view the ID of the MPS queue, perform the following steps: Log on to the MPS console. In the left-side navigation pane, choose Global Settings > Pipelines. The MPS queue is associated with a specified Message Service (MNS) topic. You can submit jobs for different services to different MPS queues. If you do not specify this parameter, the job is submitted to the default MPS queue and no MNS topic is associated with the MPS queue
parameters.help_zh: 管道ID，可以通过MPS控制台 > 全局设置 > 管道获取。⽤于区分业务，绑定消息通知。若不传，则使⽤默认管道，不绑定消息通知
parameters.name: pipeline_id

parameters.help_en:
The job configurations. The value must be a JSON object. Example: `{"SaveType":"onlysave"}`. The `SaveType` field indicates the storage type. Valid values of the SaveType field:

save: The fingerprints of the text file are saved to the text fingerprint library only if the text file is not duplicated with content in the text fingerprint library.
onlysave: The fingerprints of the text file are saved to the text fingerprint library
parameters.help_zh:
导库配置，JSON对象。 例如：`{"SaveType":"onlysave"}`。其中`SaveType`表示存储类型，取值包括：

save：去重入库。

onlysave：仅入库
parameters.name: fp_import_config

parameters.help_en: The user-defined data. The value can contain letters, digits, and special characters. The value can be up to 128 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，支持中英文、数字、特殊符号。最大长度128字节
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: The ID of the text fingerprint library to which the text file is imported. You can specify only one job of importing text files to a text fingerprint library at a time. You can obtain the library ID from the response parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170149.html operation
parameters.help_zh: DNA库ID，⽤于批量导⼊⽂本特征，⼀个库只能并⾏处理⼀个导库任务。可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170149.html的返回参数中获取
parameters.name: fp_db_id

JobId.description_en: The ID of the import job. We recommend that you save this ID for subsequent operations
JobId.description_zh: 批量导库作业ID。建议您保存此ID便于后续调用其他接口时使用
